```python
def solve(case):

    budget = case["budget"]
    
    # Start with minimum allocations

    remaining = budget - sum(allocation.values())
    
    # Sort by importance descending, then by name for tie-breaking
    sorted_segments = sorted(segments, key=lambda s: (-s["importance"], s["name"]))

        name = s["name"]
        can_add = s["capacity"] - allocation[name]
        add = min(can_add, remaining)
        allocation[name] += add
        remaining -= add
    
    return allocation
```
